validation.live: plasma-black selected through plasma-apply-desktoptheme; user confirmed the appearance.
validation.collection: JSON, INI, SVG surface opacity, geometry, source hashes and references checked without activating machine settings.

snapshot-10.description: Capture user-confirmed removal of the hostname prefix from the Konsole Bash prompt in the shared shell fragment.
snapshot-10.validation: Bash syntax, interactive prompt value, quiet noninteractive sourcing and manifest hashes checked without activating live shell settings.

snapshot-11.description: Capture the preference that pressing Super alone does not open the KDE application menu; retain Alt+F1.
snapshot-11.validation: Live KGlobalAccel readback and saved local configuration contain only Alt+F1 for the application launcher. Collection INI, JSON and manifest hashes checked without activating desktop settings during collection maintenance.

snapshot-12.description: Capture 70% opacity for active and inactive KDE windows with Firefox forced fully opaque.
snapshot-12.validation: Collection INI, Firefox-first rule order/count, JSON and manifest hashes checked without activating desktop settings during collection maintenance. The earlier live change was reconfigured and saved opacity values read back as 70/70 and 100/100 for Firefox.

snapshot-13.description: Capture 30% transparency for all KDE windows including Firefox, and a topbar tray without Bluetooth or the hidden-icons chevron.
snapshot-13.validation: Collection INI, single catch-all rule list/count, selected tray settings, JSON and manifest hashes checked without activating machine settings during collection maintenance. Earlier live KWin reconfiguration and saved-config readback confirmed 70/70 opacity with no Firefox exception; before/after topbar screenshots confirmed Bluetooth and the chevron were removed.

snapshot-14.description: Disable Firefox Resist Fingerprinting for canvas-based image upload compatibility and restore fully opaque Firefox windows while retaining 30% transparency elsewhere.
snapshot-14.validation: JavaScript syntax and literal preferences, INI, Firefox-first opacity rule list/count, JSON and updated manifest hashes checked. Authorized live KWin rule reconfigured and saved opacity values verified as 100/100 for Firefox and 70/70 for other windows. Browser user.js saved for next startup; active Firefox was not restarted. Earlier isolated canvas test: 0/1024 altered background pixels with Resist Fingerprinting disabled, 1024/1024 with it enabled. Actual ChatGPT upload retry remains unverified.

follow_up.firefox_images: User confirmed the image fix worked; the earlier upload confirmation is no longer pending.

snapshot-15.description: Record the user-confirmed Firefox image fix and collect 20 new Pictures images without copying three existing duplicates.

follow_up.firefox_images: User confirmed the image upload/paste fix worked after disabling Resist Fingerprinting.

snapshot-15.validation: All source images decoded and were reviewed in a contact sheet. SHA-256 and auto-oriented decoded RGBA pixel comparisons found three duplicates; new files were copied unchanged. Image copy hashes, collection uniqueness, existing Firefox preference/opacity synchronization, JSON and refreshed documentation hashes verified without activating browser, desktop or wallpaper settings.
